scheduled.title: How to Tell If Your "Islamic" Mortgage Is Actually Fake #halalmortgage #islamicfinance
scheduled.description:
Four questions. If your provider fails any of them, you are paying interest with an Arabic label on it.

1. Who legally owns the house while you pay?
2. Is the price fixed at signing, or does it track a rate?
3. Who pays if the property is destroyed?
4. What happens if you pay late — and where does that money go?

A late fee that becomes the bank's profit is riba by another name. That question alone rules out most of the market.

The Money Machine, Decoded.

MORE IN THE SERIES:
How to buy a house without interest (Musharaka): https://youtu.be/riQ7dLSnogo
How your mortgage costs you two houses: https://youtu.be/fMQMZKPvK4c
Murabaha, the fixed-price sale: https://youtu.be/c8uyMAIORkU
How banks quietly trap your savings: https://youtu.be/OXIP3EJROQk
{PLAYLIST_LINE}
No jargon. Just mechanisms.
Education, not financial advice — verify current terms with any provider before signing.

#HalalMortgage #IslamicFinance #Riba #Musharaka #Ijara #HalalMoney #MuslimMoney #FinanceDecoded

You did not agree to that risk. You were never asked.
